data.one_liner: Set Android home or lock screen wallpaper programmatically
data.what_it_does: This plugin lets you set a wallpaper on the Android home screen, lock screen, or both. It uses isolates to process large images without blocking the UI.
use_when: You need to change the wallpaper from your app
You have high‑resolution images and want to avoid UI lag
You want a simple API to set wallpapers on Android
avoid_when: You target iOS or other platforms
strengths: Supports home, lock, or both screens
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec, ensure Android minSdk 24, no build_runner needed
